cases.title: Compile and run final Apex release baseline
steps: Bind the qualified CLI/runtime and the verified target identity to the exact reviewed release artifact.
Review native customer automation and the permitted test scope before choosing the final test command.
When separately authorized, validate the final manifest and run the selected full product release suite; record coverage and failures without changing test assertions.
expected: No compilation failure, failed required test, or unexplained coverage issue.
Executed source and permission metadata correspond to the reviewed release artifact; all tests and target identifiers are recorded in controlled evidence.
evidence: full test result/coverage and any failure report
cleanup: Use the platform test transaction cleanup; review any customer-specific side effects separately.
cases.priorEvidenceLimit: Existing source/unit evidence does not establish the current target org or final rendered acceptance.

cases.title: Owned journey and foreign-record denial
steps: Use approved ordinary users A and B with different diagnostic ownership and recorded effective permissions.
As A capture one supported synthetic failure, open its saved alert/details and analyze the permitted context.
As B attempt the same diagnostic/notification identifiers through supported UI and server endpoints; reload A and confirm consistent state.
expected: A receives only authorized diagnostic data and permitted actions.
B receives no foreign evidence or notification details; server denial remains after reload.
No administrator identity is used as proof of End User access.
evidence: negative request outcomes with identifiers redacted outside controlled evidence
cleanup: Remove only the run-owned synthetic diagnostic graph after evidence capture; retain audit evidence according to the approved policy.
cases.priorEvidenceLimit: Existing source/unit evidence does not establish the current target org or final rendered acceptance.

cases.title: Manual Help without readable captured evidence
steps: As an approved End User create a diagnostic session with a synthetic task description and no diagnostic reference.
Analyze the session and verify guidance; repeat with a malformed/unreadable optional reference.
Review report confirmation controls without sending a message unless ACC-10 is separately authorized.
expected: Manual Help works without Error Log read access and associates no unreadable evidence.
Malformed values fail safely and stale responses do not overwrite the current reference.
No report is sent without the intended confirmation.
cleanup: Delete only run-owned sessions after recording evidence, if cleanup is authorized.
cases.priorEvidenceLimit: Existing source/unit evidence does not establish the current target org or final rendered acceptance.

cases.title: Governed correction/retry decision boundary
steps: First record whether recovery is in scope; otherwise record an approved exclusion rather than a pass.
For one reviewed registered synthetic operation exercise missing permission, absent confirmation and invalid/foreign target cases.
For an authorized actor run the intended operation once, verify its real business postcondition, then exercise duplicate/failure rollback using its reviewed fixture.
expected: Denied or unconfirmed operations make no business change.
Successful execution has the correct target, bounded side effects and durable audit.
Repeated effects are prevented by business idempotency; failed mutation is rolled back and audited.
cleanup: Restore the run-owned business fixture to its recorded prior values using the reviewed operation; do not reset audit/request keys.
cases.priorEvidenceLimit: A diagnostics-only decision can exclude this case with owner/reason recorded; no enabled customer recovery registration is assumed.

cases.title: Saved notices, streaming limitations, dismissal and reload
steps: Create two permitted synthetic notices and observe the live Aegis hint when the selected transport is available.
Exercise one disconnected/optional-stream failure and choose Refresh alerts once; observe stored results and independent channel status.
Dismiss one notice, reload, and replay one stale hint; separately inspect a Viewed/expired/foreign reference.
expected: Only canonical, authorized, unexpired state resolves; hints expose no diagnostic text.
Saved refresh is bounded and does not replay a business write or claim streaming recovery.
Dismissal survives reload and stale hints do not restore dismissed state.
cleanup: Remove run-owned notices only after evidence; restore any deliberately changed test transport configuration.
cases.priorEvidenceLimit: Existing source/unit evidence does not establish the current target org or final rendered acceptance.

cases.title: Desktop keyboard and accessibility journey
steps: Record the selected desktop browser, viewport, assistive technology and role.
Navigate alert/details, Help, validation errors, confirmation, dismissal and close/reopen with keyboard only.
Check focus order/restoration, readable labels/status/errors, zoom and the selected assistive-technology announcement behavior.
expected: Required actions are keyboard reachable with visible focus and appropriate focus restoration.
Labels, error/status announcements and zoom behavior are usable on the selected surface.
Any unsupported platform behavior is explicitly scoped and reviewed.
cleanup: Close test sessions and remove only synthetic data created for this run.
cases.priorEvidenceLimit: Existing source/unit evidence does not establish the current target org or final rendered acceptance.

cases.title: Selected mobile/responsive surface
requires: agreed mobile surface and available test device
steps: Select the actual supported mobile surface with the product owner before execution.
Run the essential read/Help/confirmation/dismissal journey on that available surface at the selected small-screen size.
Record unavailable native features and agree exclusions; never assume desktop utility bars exist in the native mobile app.
expected: Selected supported actions are readable and operable without clipped critical controls.
Platform limitations and excluded surfaces have an explicit owner decision; they are not reported as tested.
cleanup: Remove run-owned synthetic data and restore test settings.
cases.priorEvidenceLimit: Existing source/unit evidence does not establish the current target org or final rendered acceptance.

cases.title: One real Email delivery and replay
steps: Record the approved test recipient, sender identity, route, deliverability and exact synthetic evidence.
Confirm and request one escalation; inspect durable escalation/delivery records and the recipient-side result.
Repeat the same source/route request once and inspect for suppression; reconcile any uncertain result before any further operation.
expected: Exactly one intended email reaches the approved destination with permitted masked evidence.
The durable audit/claim is consistent with the destination-side outcome.
Replay reuses the request and produces no second message.
evidence: recipient/sender approval stored in controlled evidence
cleanup: A sent email cannot be rolled back; manage its retention with the approved recipient. Remove test diagnostics only as approved.
cases.priorEvidenceLimit: Mocks and queued/sent labels alone do not prove receipt; this case performs a real external side effect only after selection.

cases.title: One intended Case delivery and replay
steps: Record the approved Case owner/queue, native permissions, assignment/notification automation and synthetic subject.
Confirm one Case escalation and verify the created Case plus durable audit.
Repeat the same source/route request once and verify there is no second Case.
expected: Exactly one intended Case is created with permitted masked evidence and expected ownership.
Configured Case automation produces no unapproved notifications/side effects.
Replay does not create another Case.
cleanup: Close/delete only the run-owned Case as authorized; preserve required audit history and handle any emitted notification separately.
cases.priorEvidenceLimit: Existing source/unit evidence does not establish the current target org or final rendered acceptance.

cases.title: Flow backlog across a full page and late arrival
requires: reviewed failure fixture and capacity budget
steps: Agree capacity and a reviewed fixture producing 201 distinct failed interviews or an explicitly approved equivalent; do not insert fake FlowInterview records into a live org.
Record the starting cursor and all fixture identities, including the 200 already-captured comparison rows where applicable.
Observe at most three bounded sweeps over the page boundary, including one approved late arrival after reset.
expected: The cursor advances past already-captured rows and the next distinct failure is not hidden.
Each observed interview has the correct correlation/replay result, then the sweep resets.
Late-arrival behavior, drain latency and actual governor/automation cost are recorded.
evidence: latency, capture reconciliation and governor evidence
cleanup: Clean up only approved run-owned interviews/diagnostics through supported procedures; restore recorded cursor/schedule configuration only with administrator review.
cases.priorEvidenceLimit: The existing injected EvidenceSource test proves algorithm behavior, not 201 real failed interviews or target-org load.

cases.title: Async backlog across a full page and completion-time boundary
requires: reviewed async fixture and daily capacity budget
steps: Agree capacity and a reviewed fixture for 101 completed failed jobs plus at most one late completion.
Record job identities, created/completed times and starting async cursor; keep the Flow cursor observation separate.
Observe at most three bounded sweeps and reconcile captures/replays across the 100-job page boundary.
expected: Selection follows completion-time/keyset progress, not only job creation time.
The 101st distinct failure is processed, duplicate captures are avoided and sweep reset handles the late completion.
The Flow cursor and unrelated setup fields are unchanged.
evidence: per-page async and Flow cursor observations
cleanup: Review retained platform job history and remove only authorized run-owned diagnostics; restore recorded schedule/cursor configuration if a change was authorized.
cases.priorEvidenceLimit: Existing source/unit evidence does not establish the current target org or final rendered acceptance.

cases.title: Genuine concurrent escalation requests
requires: approved delivery route/destination and side-effect budget
steps: Choose one approved synthetic diagnostic, one route and two authorized clients with a common start barrier.
Issue exactly two simultaneous requests for the same source/route; save request timing and durable result identifiers.
After reconciliation issue one sequential replay and verify the destination-side count.
expected: Two real concurrent callers yield one durable claim and one intended delivery.
A loser/replay cannot implicitly resend a failed, pending or historically attempted delivery.
Uncertain remote state is retained for reconciliation; it is never treated as proof of non-delivery.
cleanup: Retain delivery/claim evidence and perform only reviewed run-owned cleanup; external effects require destination-side handling.
cases.priorEvidenceLimit: Sequential calls or one Apex transaction do not establish genuine concurrent contention.

cases.title: Capture rejection, bounded retry and final publication failure
steps: Start with the existing Apex test seams; separately review any runtime failure-injection fixture before enabling it.
Exercise one permanent rejection, one bounded transient failure and one final publication failure without abandoning a valid item in the same controlled batch.
Record sanitized durable telemetry, attribution, retry budget and cleanup; verify a publish rejection returns no accepted reference.
expected: Rejected/finally failed items are durably visible without exposing synthetic secret values.
Valid siblings are not silently lost and transient retries remain inside the platform/service budget.
Publication acceptance and actual persistence are reported separately.
evidence: reviewed injection scope and per-item outcomes
cleanup: Disable/remove only the reviewed test injection and its run-owned data; preserve required telemetry evidence.
cases.priorEvidenceLimit: Existing source/unit evidence does not establish the current target org or final rendered acceptance.

cases.title: Batch scope identity and event replay
steps: Use two approved failure scopes from one controlled Batch job with distinct event identities.
Observe both captures, then replay one scope identity through the reviewed fixture once.
Compare resulting correlation/diagnostic identities and counts.
expected: Different failed scopes remain distinct.
Replaying the same scope identity creates no additional diagnostic.
cleanup: Remove only approved run-owned diagnostics; retain required platform job/audit history.
cases.priorEvidenceLimit: Existing source/unit evidence does not establish the current target org or final rendered acceptance.

cases.title: Privacy, affected-user evidence and outbound masking
steps: Use two approved ordinary actors and synthetic sensitive markers only; record the field/context allowlist.
Compare own and foreign UI/API/context reads and a privileged processor acting for the other affected user.
Where explicitly selected, compare storage and outbound evidence masking; optional debug-log/AI/connector checks require their separate setup.
expected: Sharing/CRUD/FLS and sensitive-context boundaries hold for each selected role.
A processor does not build a fresh business snapshot under its own rights for a different affected user.
Synthetic sensitive markers are masked in the selected storage/outbound boundaries; no real credentials or customer data are used.
evidence: sanitized storage and permitted outbound comparisons
foreign-read denial and affected-user omission marker
cleanup: Remove only approved synthetic data; retain sanitized evidence and do not copy unmasked content to reports.
cases.priorEvidenceLimit: Existing source/unit evidence does not establish the current target org or final rendered acceptance.

cases.title: Lifecycle durations, grouping and coverage reconciliation
steps: Observe one legacy/unknown-timing synthetic diagnostic and one newly diagnosed/resolved/reopened record through supported services.
Attempt an unauthorized protected-field write and make one unrelated permitted update.
Compare stored transitions/formulas, long grouping keys with distinct object/time/source suffixes and exact observed-interview coverage.
expected: Unknown timing stays null; unrelated edits do not rewrite lifecycle timestamps or durations.
Reopen/resolution transitions behave correctly and protected writes are denied.
Long keys preserve distinctions and historical Flow counts do not hide a new uncaptured interview.
cleanup: Remove only run-owned records as approved; never backfill historical timestamps or rewrite real incident groups for the test.
cases.priorEvidenceLimit: Existing source/unit evidence does not establish the current target org or final rendered acceptance.

cases.title: Nonproduction rollback rehearsal for the chosen release model
requires: fresh source/configuration and business-data recovery plan
steps: Bind a fresh pre-change target source/configuration snapshot, approved artifact and restoration/cleanup scope; verify their hashes.
Rehearse the selected source/configuration recovery in the authorized nonproduction target using the reviewed runbook.
Verify permission/configuration preservation, diagnostic capture and business-data invariants, then record recovery time and cleanup.
expected: The agreed baseline is restored without erasing business edits, diagnostic history or audit/request keys.
Subscriber identities, schedules, feature overlays, routes, permissions and enabled Flow versions match the approved recovery target.
Sent email/external actions are reconciled separately; source rollback is not reported as reversing them.
evidence: business-data invariants, recovery timing and owner review
cleanup: Restore the agreed end state and remove only approved test artifacts; preserve recovery/evidence records.
cases.priorEvidenceLimit: Local source archive extraction/hash restoration proves only file integrity; it is not an org, data or external-side-effect rollback rehearsal.
